title: Relational databases
brief: Understand shared relational facts, questions and guarded changes through one shop purchase. Distinguish schema rules, atomicity, concurrent decisions, query work and durability, judge relational fit and choose a practical next route.
ownership_note: Introduce enough of each concern to choose a route; children own detailed design, formal analysis and working procedures.

title: PostgreSQL vacuum and transaction age
brief: Diagnose retained PostgreSQL versions, visibility and transaction-age risk before changing maintenance. Distinguish reusable space from bloat and file shrinkage; choose vacuum and related interventions from retained horizons and age evidence.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-architecture: Owns first visibility and HOT explanation.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns standby and slot retention policy.

title: PostgreSQL index methods and operators
brief: Choose a PostgreSQL access method and operator class from the operator’s meaning and data organisation. Compare B-tree, hash, GIN, GiST, SP-GiST and BRIN, and verify candidates, rechecks and write costs in native plans.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-schema-change: Owns concurrent builds, invalid indexes and native maintenance procedures.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-text: Owns linguistic text retrieval and ranking.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-extensions: Owns specialised type and extension dependencies.

title: Reading and repairing PostgreSQL plans
brief: Interpret EXPLAIN ANALYZE counters without confusing estimates, per-loop work, buffers or timings. Test statistics, access paths and prepared-plan repairs under skew and workload variation.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-indexes: Owns native method and operator semantics.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-operations: Owns waits and admission outside plan execution.

title: PostgreSQL JSON and structured alternatives
brief: Choose columns, related rows or JSONB from the facts, validation and update boundary. Match native JSON operators and indexes while preserving established identities, types and data rules.

neighbouring_ownership.data-modelling: Owns introductory JSON versus tables versus EAV judgement.
neighbouring_ownership.values: Owns general equality and value representation.

title: PostgreSQL WAL, checkpoints and durability
brief: Interpret PostgreSQL WAL progress, checkpoint work and commit settings against a tested durability promise. Explain an isolated crash drill and its restart evidence without extrapolating to power loss or lost storage.

neighbouring_ownership.storage-durability: Owns general mechanism and failure distinctions.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-backup: Owns backup chains, targets and restore.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns standby progress and synchronous-copy promises.

title: Restoring PostgreSQL to a recovery target
brief: Build and test a base-backup and archived-WAL chain, restore a verified target and account for valid work outside the recovered history. Close source writes before reconciliation and preserve external-effect identity.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-replication: Owns promoting an existing physical copy.

title: PostgreSQL physical replicas and promotion
brief: Operate a physical standby with separate receipt, flush and replay evidence. Choose synchronous promises, perform fenced promotion with an explicit loss boundary, and return a former primary safely.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-logical-replication: Owns selective row streams and their separate lifecycle.

title: PostgreSQL logical replication and change feeds
brief: Configure a publication and subscriber with deliberate replica identity. Treat the stream as selective row changes, accounting for schema, sequences, lag, retained log and cutover responsibilities.

neighbouring_ownership.outboxes-jobs: Owns durable application intentions and delivery semantics.
neighbouring_ownership.pg-upgrades: Owns full migration acceptance and write handover.

title: PostgreSQL schema changes under load
topic: PostgreSQL live schema and index work
brief: Choose native schema and index operations from their lock, rewrite and validity behaviour. Bound waits, validate backfill convergence and maintain indexes without accepting incomplete semantic or physical work.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-indexes: Owns which access method serves the query.

title: Operating and diagnosing PostgreSQL
brief: Trace a request through pool and server evidence to distinguish blocked work, excessive execution and connection pressure. Test a targeted intervention with bounded waits and account for recovery costs.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vacuum: Owns version retention and age repair.

title: PostgreSQL roles, policies and privileged code
brief: Test role inheritance, ownership and row-policy boundaries as the actual application identities. Explain bypass cases and secure privileged routines against identity and name-resolution mistakes.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-extensions: Owns extension installation and lifecycle privileges.

title: Upgrading and migrating PostgreSQL
brief: Choose between a major upgrade and a logical migration, then rehearse compatibility, a recoverable write handover and acceptance. Identify the point after which a simple return is no longer possible.

neighbouring_ownership.crdb-migration: Owns the PostgreSQL-to-CockroachDB application contract transfer.

title: Distributing PostgreSQL work
brief: Choose among native partitions, application shards, Citus and foreign tables from co-location, invariant scope and movement needs. Derive local work, skew and fan-out, then preserve single ownership through a transfer.

neighbouring_ownership.partitioning: Owns native table-pruning and lifecycle concepts.

title: Types and extensions in PostgreSQL
topic: PostgreSQL specialised types and extension lifecycle
brief: Express overlap and spatial predicates with suitable types, operators and indexes. Own extension installation, privileges, dependencies, restore, upgrade and removal, including when an extension becomes part of the application’s durability contract.

neighbouring_ownership.pg-vector: Owns complete vector retrieval and evaluation.
